# Renderer fixtures

These original Apache-2.0 inputs and expected reports cover all three verdicts,
every independently reported field, and each value representation. They include
full entries, null values, policy rationales and unused-rule warnings. Their
digests are illustrative metadata and do not identify external firmware.

The `.golden` files contain the exact expected JSON and Markdown output.
Renderer tests compare against those bytes to check normalization, escaping
and deterministic output.
